# bko-holt load plan for layout.json
# Source: host1, Ubuntu Stonking Stingray (development branch), UEFI boot with grub, dumped 2026-11-18T20:26:06Z
#
# Disks:
#   nvme0n1 (477 GiB, SAMSUNG MZVL8512HFLU-00BLL, serial SERIAL1) -> /dev/sdq
#
# Notes:
#   - dm-1 (label-1): plain dm-crypt that crypttab makes at every boot with a random key from /dev/urandom (swap): nothing is made on nvme0n1p3 but the partition (its ends zeroed, as every new partition's); the restored system's crypttab makes it at its first boot
#   - ZFS volume rpool/keystore: made empty; archivers back up files, not zvols

# ---- partition ----
# nvme0n1 -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# nvme0n1p1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2201600 count=2048 conv=fsync
# nvme0n1p2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2203648 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6395904 count=2048 conv=fsync
# nvme0n1p3: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=6397952 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=14784512 count=2048 conv=fsync
# nvme0n1p4: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=14786560 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=1000210432 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: gpt
label-id: bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512
table-length: 128
first-lba: 2048
last-lba: 1000215182

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=2201600, type=C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003
/dev/sdq2 : start=2203648, size=4194304, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
/dev/sdq3 : start=6397952, size=8388608, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007
/dev/sdq4 : start=14786560, size=985425920, type=0FC63DAF-8483-4772-8E79-3D69D8477DE4, uuid=BC000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt/keys
# ZFS encryption root rpool: a new raw key (the data is all rewritten by the restore)
sh -c 'umask 077; head -c 32 /dev/urandom > /run/bko-holt/keys/rpool'
# ZFS pool rpool, with the source's feature flags only
zpool create -f -d -o cachefile=none -o ashift=12 -o autotrim=on -o feature@async_destroy=enabled -o feature@empty_bpobj=enabled -o feature@lz4_compress=enabled -o feature@multi_vdev_crash_dump=enabled -o feature@spacemap_histogram=enabled -o feature@enabled_txg=enabled -o feature@hole_birth=enabled -o feature@extensible_dataset=enabled -o feature@embedded_data=enabled -o feature@bookmarks=enabled -o feature@filesystem_limits=enabled -o feature@large_blocks=enabled -o feature@large_dnode=enabled -o feature@sha512=enabled -o feature@skein=enabled -o feature@edonr=enabled -o feature@userobj_accounting=enabled -o feature@encryption=enabled -o feature@project_quota=enabled -o feature@device_removal=enabled -o feature@obsolete_counts=enabled -o feature@zpool_checkpoint=enabled -o feature@spacemap_v2=enabled -o feature@allocation_classes=enabled -o feature@resilver_defer=enabled -o feature@bookmark_v2=enabled -o feature@redaction_bookmarks=enabled -o feature@redacted_datasets=enabled -o feature@bookmark_written=enabled -o feature@log_spacemap=enabled -o feature@livelist=enabled -o feature@device_rebuild=enabled -o feature@zstd_compress=enabled -o feature@draid=enabled -o feature@zilsaxattr=enabled -o feature@head_errlog=enabled -o feature@blake3=enabled -o feature@block_cloning=enabled -o feature@vdev_zaps_v2=enabled -o feature@redaction_list_spill=enabled -o feature@raidz_expansion=enabled -o feature@fast_dedup=enabled -o feature@longname=enabled -o feature@large_microzap=enabled -o feature@dynamic_gang_header=enabled -o feature@block_cloning_endian=enabled -o feature@physical_rewrite=enabled -O mountpoint=/ -O compression=lz4 -O devices=off -O canmount=off -O xattr=sa -O sync=standard -O dnodesize=auto -O acltype=posix -O relatime=on -O normalization=formD -O utf8only=on -O encryption=aes-256-gcm -O keyformat=raw -O keylocation=file:///run/bko-holt/keys/rpool -R /mnt/bko-target rpool /dev/sdq4
# the source pool's GUID (vdev GUIDs can't be kept)
zpool reguid -g 10000000000000000001 rpool
# mount mounts every dataset in order
sh -c '[ "$(zfs get -H -o value mounted rpool)" != yes ] || zfs unmount rpool'
zfs create -V 20971520 -o refreservation=23592960 -o volblocksize=16384 -o encryption=off rpool/keystore
# udev links /dev/zvol/rpool/keystore a moment after zfs create
sh -c 'i=0; until udevadm settle; [ -b /dev/zvol/rpool/keystore ]; do i=$((i + 1)); [ $i -lt 30 ] || { echo /dev/zvol/rpool/keystore": no such block device 30 s after zfs create (udev never linked it)" >&2; exit 1; }; sleep 1; done'
# LUKS2 on /dev/zvol/rpool/keystore: asks for the new passphrase
cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type=luks2 --uuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009 /dev/zvol/rpool/keystore
cryptsetup open /dev/zvol/rpool/keystore keystore-rpool

# ---- format ----
# nvme0n1p1: vfat
mkfs.fat -F 32 -i BC000002 -S 512 -s 8 -f 2 -R 32 -h 2048 /dev/sdq1
# check: /dev/sdq1 is vfat with the source's FAT size, sector and cluster size (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# nvme0n1p2: ext4
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,has_journal,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,orphan_file,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,metadata_csum_seed,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005 -b 4096 -I 256 -N 131072 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006,desc_size=64,resize=536870912 /dev/sdq2 2097152k
tune2fs -r 26214 /dev/sdq2
# check: /dev/sdq2 is ext4 with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
# dm-0: ext4 "keystore-rpool"
mke2fs -F -q -t ext4 -O none,ext_attr,resize_inode,dir_index,filetype,extent,64bit,flex_bg,metadata_csum_seed,sparse_super,large_file,huge_file,dir_nlink,extra_isize,metadata_csum -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a -L keystore-rpool -b 4096 -I 256 -N 1024 -g 32768 -G 16 -E hash_seed=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b,stride=4,stripe_width=8192,desc_size=64 /dev/mapper/keystore-rpool 4096k
tune2fs -r 51 /dev/mapper/keystore-rpool
# check: /dev/mapper/keystore-rpool is ext4 with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=none -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/ -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/srv
zfs create -u -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/usr
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/usr/local
zfs create -u -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/games
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/AccountsService
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/NetworkManager
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/apt
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/dpkg
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/log
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/mail
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/snap
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/spool
zfs create -u -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/www
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=none -o canmount=off -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/USERDATA
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/home -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/USERDATA/home_v5hcgt
zfs create -u -o mountpoint=/root -o canmount=on -o normalization=formD -o utf8only=on rpool/USERDATA/root_v5hcgt
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/keystore
# rpool's key file /run/keystore/rpool/system.key lives on /dev/mapper/keystore-rpool
mount /dev/mapper/keystore-rpool /run/bko-holt/keystore
mkdir -p /run/bko-holt/keystore
install -m 400 /run/bko-holt/keys/rpool /run/bko-holt/keystore/system.key
umount /run/bko-holt/keystore

# ---- mount ----
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot
mount -t ext4 -o defaults /dev/sdq2 /mnt/bko-target/boot
zfs mount rpool/USERDATA/home_v5hcgt
zfs mount rpool/USERDATA/root_v5hcgt
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/srv
mkdir -p /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
mount -t vfat -o defaults /dev/sdq1 /mnt/bko-target/boot/efi
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/usr/local
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/games
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/log
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/mail
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/snap
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/spool
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/www
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/AccountsService
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/NetworkManager
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/apt
zfs mount rpool/ROOT/ubuntu_xv8vu7/var/lib/dpkg

# ---- restore ----
# snapshot latest of /srv/bko-repo, with BackOtter's restore flags
RUSTIC_STRICT_EXIT=true rustic-bko --repository /srv/bko-repo --no-progress restore --numeric-id latest /mnt/bko-target
# the atimes the restore set, for boot to put back after its reads
sh -c 'mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before'

# ---- boot ----
# refuses to start unless /mnt/bko-target/etc/fstab is the restored system's (its / matches the layout's)
# rpool: unlocks as the source did
zfs set keylocation=file:///run/keystore/rpool/system.key rpool
# the restored system's zpool.cache names the new pool
zpool set cachefile=/mnt/bko-target/etc/zfs/zpool.cache rpool
# / with the source's atime options (rw,nodev,relatime), for host-only dracut's rootflags=
mount -o remount,atime,relatime /mnt/bko-target
# the restored atimes (the restore stage lists them), to put back after this stage's reads
sh -c '[ -s /run/bko-holt/atimes.before ] || { mkdir -p -m 700 /run/bko-holt && find /mnt/bko-target \( -path /mnt/bko-target/dev -o -path /mnt/bko-target/proc -o -path /mnt/bko-target/sys -o -path /mnt/bko-target/run \) -prune -o -printf '\''%A@\t%p\0'\'' | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /run/bko-holt/atimes.before; }'
# the restored LVM devices file, kept
sh -c 'rm -rf /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices; [ ! -d /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices ] || { cp -a /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm/devices /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices && touch -r /mnt/bko-target/etc/lvm /run/bko-holt/lvm-devices.parent; }'
mount --rbind --make-rslave /dev /mnt/bko-target/dev
mount --rbind --make-rslave /proc /mnt/bko-target/proc
mount --rbind --make-rslave /sys /mnt/bko-target/sys
mount --rbind --make-rslave /run /mnt/bko-target/run
chroot /mnt/bko-target sh -c 'n=0; for k in /lib/modules/*; do [ -d "$k/kernel" ] || continue; l=$(lsinitrd -k "${k##*/}" 2>/dev/null); m=; for p in $(printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$l" | sed -n '\''s|^.* \(\(usr/\)*lib/modules/[^ ]*\.ko[.a-z0-9]*\)$|\1|p'\''); do [ -e "/$p" ] && b=${p##*/} && m="$m ${b%%.ko*}"; done; a=; f=; if printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$l" | sed -n '\''/^dracut modules:$/,/^=/p'\'' | grep -qx resume; then a=resume; r=$(lsinitrd -k "${k##*/}" -f etc/cmdline.d/95resume.conf 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$r" ] || { f=$(mktemp) && printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$r" > "$f"; } || exit; fi; dracut --force --kver "${k##*/}" ${m:+--add-drivers "$m"} ${a:+--add "$a"} ${f:+--include "$f" /etc/cmdline.d/95resume.conf}; s=$?; [ -z "$f" ] || rm -f "$f"; [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || exit "$s"; n=$((n + 1)); done; [ "$n" -gt 0 ]'
chroot /mnt/bko-target grub-install --target=x86_64-efi --efi-directory=/boot/efi --bootloader-id=ubuntu --no-nvram
